criteria: Exact bytes, original input unchanged, completed turn, successful shell command, case-specific extra files or nonzero recovery command; unchanged from Responses suite.

results.prompt: Copy input.txt to result.txt exactly.

commandEvidence.command: /bin/zsh -lc 'cp input.txt result.txt && cmp input.txt result.txt && echo "IDENTICAL" && ls -la result.txt'

results.prompt: Convert input.txt to uppercase in result.txt.

commandEvidence.command: /bin/zsh -lc 'echo "=== result.txt ==="; cat result.txt; echo "=== verify ==="; test "$(cat result.txt)" = "ALPHA BETA" && echo "PASS: matches expected uppercase output" || echo "FAIL"; echo "=== input.txt preserved ==="; cat input.txt'

results.prompt: Sort input.txt lines alphabetically into result.txt.

commandEvidence.command: /bin/zsh -lc 'sort input.txt > result.txt && echo "---RESULT---" && cat result.txt && echo "---HEX---" && xxd result.txt'

/bin/zsh -lc "echo \"--- input.txt unchanged (sha) ---\"
shasum input.txt
echo \"expected sha of 18-byte original:\"
printf 'zebra\\napple\\nmango\\n' | shasum
echo \"--- result.txt is sorted? ---\"
sort -c result.txt && echo \"OK: result.txt is in sorted order\"
echo \"--- result.txt matches sort of input.txt? (diff, empty = match) ---\"
diff <(sort input.txt) result.txt && echo \"OK: identical to sort(input.txt)\"
echo \"--- result.txt line count vs input.txt ---\"
wc -l < input.txt; wc -l < result.txt"

results.prompt: Remove duplicate lines preserving order into result.txt.

commandEvidence.command: /bin/zsh -lc "awk '"'!seen[$0]++'"' input.txt > result.txt; echo \"--- result.txt\"; cat result.txt; echo \"--- input.txt unchanged\"; cat input.txt; echo \"--- verify\"; awk '"'!seen[$0]++'"' input.txt | diff - result.txt && echo \"MATCH: result.txt is correct order-preserving dedup of input.txt\""

results.prompt: Sum integers in input.txt; write only the sum and newline to result.txt.

commandEvidence.command: /bin/zsh -lc "awk '{s+="'$1} END{print s}'"' input.txt > result.txt && cat result.txt && md5 -q input.txt 2>/dev/null || md5sum input.txt"

results.prompt: Copy only lines containing ERROR to result.txt.
results.input:
INFO ok
ERROR one
WARN no
ERROR two

commandEvidence.command: /bin/zsh -lc 'grep ERROR input.txt > result.txt; echo "---"; cat result.txt; echo "---"; wc -l input.txt result.txt'

results.prompt: Replace all OLD with NEW in result.txt, preserve other text.

commandEvidence.command: /bin/zsh -lc "sed 's/OLD/NEW/g' input.txt > result.txt && echo \"== result.txt ==\" && cat result.txt && echo \"== verify no OLD ==\" && grep -c OLD result.txt; echo \"grep exit: "'$?" && echo "== input.txt intact ==" && cat input.txt'

results.prompt: Reverse line order into result.txt.

commandEvidence.command: /bin/zsh -lc 'echo "== input.txt ==" && cat input.txt && echo "== result.txt ==" && cat result.txt && echo "== checks ==" && wc -l < input.txt && wc -l < result.txt && diff <(tail -r input.txt) result.txt && echo "VERIFIED: result.txt is the reversed input"'

results.prompt: Copy input.txt to the file 中文 空格.txt and result.txt exactly.

commandEvidence.command: /bin/zsh -lc "cat input.txt; echo '---'; wc -c input.txt; echo '---'; xxd input.txt"
/bin/zsh -lc 'cp input.txt "中文 空格.txt" && cp input.txt result.txt && ls -la'
/bin/zsh -lc 'cmp input.txt "中文 空格.txt" && echo "中文 空格.txt: identical"; cmp input.txt result.txt && echo "result.txt: identical"'
/bin/zsh -lc "cksum input.txt \"中文 空格.txt\" result.txt; echo '---'; xxd \"中文 空格.txt\"; echo '---'; xxd result.txt"

results.prompt: Read JSON input.txt, write its name value with newline to result.txt.

commandEvidence.command: /bin/zsh -lc "jq -r '.name' input.txt > result.txt && cat result.txt && od -c result.txt | tail -3"
/bin/zsh -lc 'ls -la && cat input.txt && test "$(cat result.txt)" = "coAgent" && echo "VERIFY OK"'

results.prompt: Sum the amount column of CSV input.txt; write only sum and newline to result.txt.

commandEvidence.command: /bin/zsh -lc "awk -F, 'NR>1 {s+="'$2} END {print s}'"' input.txt > result.txt && cat result.txt && od -c result.txt"
/bin/zsh -lc 'echo "--- input.txt (unchanged) ---"; cat input.txt; echo "--- result.txt ---"; cat result.txt; echo "--- byte check ---"; od -c result.txt; echo "--- files ---"; ls -la'

results.prompt: Count nonempty lines; write only count and newline to result.txt.
Trim whitespace from each input line into result.txt.

commandEvidence.command: /bin/zsh -lc 'cat -e input.txt; echo "---"; wc -l input.txt; file input.txt'
/bin/zsh -lc "while IFS= read -r line; do printf '%s\\n' \""'$line" | sed '"'s/"'^[[:space:]]*//; s/[[:space:]]*$//'"'; done < input.txt > result.txt; cat -e result.txt"
/bin/zsh -lc 'echo "== result.txt =="; cat -e result.txt; echo "== input.txt (unchanged) =="; cat -e input.txt; echo "== line counts =="; wc -l input.txt result.txt'
/bin/zsh -lc "diff <(sed 's/"'^[[:space:]]*//; s/[[:space:]]*$//'"' input.txt) result.txt && echo \"VERIFIED: result.txt equals trimmed input\""

results.prompt: Join lines with commas and final newline in result.txt.
Extract Markdown headings without hash prefixes into result.txt.
Fix the typo teh to the, writing result.txt.

commandEvidence.command: /bin/zsh -lc "grep -c 'teh' result.txt; echo \"exit="'$?"; cat input.txt; cat result.txt'

results.prompt: Create nested/a.txt containing input.txt and copy it to result.txt.

commandEvidence.command: /bin/zsh -lc 'mkdir -p nested && cp input.txt nested/a.txt && cp nested/a.txt result.txt && ls -la nested && echo "--- a.txt ---" && cat nested/a.txt && echo "--- result.txt ---" && cat result.txt && echo "--- verify ---" && cmp input.txt nested/a.txt && cmp nested/a.txt result.txt && diff -r <(cat input.txt) <(cat result.txt) && echo "OK: all match"'

results.prompt: Create empty result.txt (zero bytes). Input is unrelated.

commandEvidence.command: /bin/zsh -lc "ls -la; printf '' > result.txt; ls -l result.txt; wc -c < result.txt"

results.prompt: Run exactly false as a standalone shell tool call (not combined with any other command) and observe its nonzero exit status. Then recover using a separate successful shell tool call to copy input.txt to result.txt.

commandEvidence.command: /bin/zsh -lc 'ls -l input.txt result.txt; cmp input.txt result.txt && echo "MATCH: result.txt is identical to input.txt"'

results.prompt: Split input.txt into one.txt first line and two.txt second line; concatenate them into result.txt.

commandEvidence.command: /bin/zsh -lc 'cat -v input.txt; echo "---exit:$?"; wc -l -c input.txt; xxd input.txt'

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1p' input.txt > one.txt; sed -n '2p' input.txt > two.txt; cat one.txt two.txt > result.txt; echo \"== one ==\"; cat one.txt; echo \"== two ==\"; cat two.txt; echo \"== result ==\"; cat result.txt; echo \"== xxd result ==\"; xxd result.txt"

/bin/zsh -lc 'cmp <(cat one.txt two.txt) result.txt && echo "VERIFY: result.txt == one.txt + two.txt (OK)"; echo "--- input.txt intact ---"; xxd input.txt; echo "--- files ---"; ls -la one.txt two.txt result.txt input.txt'
